source.author: verg
source.text: O pater, anne aliquas ad caelum hinc ire putandum est sublimis animas, iterumque ad tarda reverti corpora?
source.text_original: 'O pater, anne aliquas ad caelum hinc ire putandum est / sublimis animas, iterumque ad tarda reverti / corpora?
source.text_english: O father, is it then to be thought that some souls go up from here to heaven, and return again to sluggish bodies?

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: unde Vergilius: o pater, anne aliquas ad caelum hinc ire putandum est sublimis animas iterumque ad tarda reuerti corpora?
reuse.text_original: unde Vergilius: o pater, anne aliquas ad caelum hinc ire putandum est sublimis animas iterumque ad tarda reuerti corpora?
reuse.text_english: Whence Virgil says: O father, then must we think that some souls, soaring hence to heaven, go and return again to sluggish bodies?
